head: 8 new utility apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These utility apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Utilities charts this week, most of them made for the foldable iPhone Duo, from Safari extensions to desk clocks and a fold counter.
where: iPhone, US App Store Utilities charts (paid, plus WorkBuddy in free) this week
means: If you have an iPhone Duo, several of these were made for its folding screen; the clocks, roam and WorkBuddy work on other iPhones too.
todo: Check each App Store page before you buy: Desky needs an iPhone Duo for its Safari extension, and Fold Counter needs iOS 27.2 or later to count folds while it's closed.

list.name: Desky - Desktop Mode Switching
list.what: A Safari extension that shows websites in desktop mode when your iPhone Duo is open and mobile mode when it's folded.

list.name: Clackity – Duo Flip Clock
list.what: A split-flap clock like an old train station board, with the date, weather and battery around it.

list.name: Sidefill: Wide View for Safari
list.what: A Safari extension that stretches web pages under Safari's side controls on the iPhone Duo's outer screen.

list.name: Fold Counter: Hinge Tracker
list.what: Counts every fold and unfold of a foldable iPhone and estimates how much of the hinge's life you've used.

list.name: Grandeur Link
list.what: Shows your Mac's screen on your iPhone over your home network, with a keyboard and trackpad to control it.

list.name: roam - one tap travel alarms
list.what: Alarms tied to time zones: each one rings only while your phone is in that zone.

list.name: Tunnel Time – Duo Desk Clock
list.what: A desk clock where ants dig each digit of the time, with the real sky and weather above.

list.name: WorkBuddy - AI Work Agent
list.what: Tencent's AI work agent that plans the steps of a task and hands back reports, tables or videos.
